originalTitle: August was the month of the comeback kids. Cramer reviews what drove the biggest winners
summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said August was a comeback month for stocks that had been battered by bearish narratives.
content:
CNBC's Jim Cramer said Monday that August was a comeback month for stocks that had been battered by some of Wall Street's most powerful bearish narratives.

His comments came on the final trading day of August. Several of the S&P 500 's biggest winners in August spent months under pressure from concerns ranging from artificial intelligence disruption to slowing growth. Cramer said improving fundamentals helped challenge those fears and fuel sharp rebounds.

Moderna led the index in August after announcing promising results for its experimental melanoma vaccine developed with Merck , challenging skepticism about whether its mRNA technology could produce another major breakthrough . "This is miraculous, so it got a miraculous welcome," Cramer said. Prior to 2026, Moderna shares had spent years under pressure as demand waned for its Covid-19 vaccine.

Enterprise software accounted for many of the other big rebounds in August. Palantir , Veeva Systems , Salesforce and ServiceNow had all faced varying degrees of selling as investors questioned the durability of software in the AI era. Cramer said those declines were exacerbated by the presence of Situational Awareness, a highly leveraged fund that had made large bets against software stocks based on that thesis. Situational Awareness was forced to unwind its trades in late July.

"As August comes to a grinding end, it's hard to believe that the reverberations of a hedge fund implosion could color so much of the month's action," he said.

Cramer said Palantir's earlier decline never made sense given its exceptional combination of revenue growth and profitability. Salesforce rebounded after a strong quarter undercut fears of the "SaaSpocalypse ," while ServiceNow rallied after showing it could successfully integrate AI into its existing business . Veeva, which is focused on the life sciences industry, also bounced back alongside the broader software group after fears that AI would disrupt its business proved overblown.

"The comeback in software from incredibly depressed levels was breathtaking," Cramer said.

Gartner joined the rebound after earlier being hit by concerns that AI models such as Anthropic's Claude could diminish the need for its technology research. Cramer said those fears ultimately weren't reflected in the company's business.

Outside software, miner Newmont benefited from an emerging recovery in the price of gold, which had been soared last year and into early 2026, before topping out. To be sure, Cramer said he prefers the stock of fellow miner Agnico Eagle Mines over Newmont.

Paramount Skydance also bounced back as its proposed Warner Bros. Discovery acquisition remained delayed. Last week, California Attorney General Rob Bonta canceled a meeting with Paramount Skydance because the company demonstrated a "lack of good faith" in early settlement talks. Cramer said investors think Paramount is overpaying, meaning the roadblocks to completing the deal have actually helped the stock.

Super Micro Computer and Sandisk also surged as booming demand for memory used in AI data centers lifted both stocks. Super Micro's rally came despite continued scrutiny surrounding its business in China. For its part, Sandisk's strength in August came after a brutal July that saw shares fall over 46%. The stock remains about 33% below its late June closing high.

Coinbase also landed among the month's top performers as cryptocurrencies rebounded. The rally came as concerns about ballooning government spending and the rising cost of U.S. debt drove investors toward perceived hard assets as a hedge against a weaker dollar . Cramer noted the stock has become a popular proxy for investors seeking exposure to the broader crypto market.

chineseTitle: 八月是孩子们回归的月份。克莱默回顾了最大赢家的推动因素
chineseSummary: CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，8 月是遭受看跌言论打击的股票卷土重来的月份。
chineseContent:
CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 周一表示，对于那些受到华尔街一些最强烈的看跌言论打击的股票来说，8 月份是一个卷土重来的月份。

他的评论是在八月的最后一个交易日发表的。 8 月份标准普尔 500 指数的几家最大赢家连续几个月承受着人工智能颠覆和增长放缓等担忧的压力。克莱默表示，基本面的改善有助于挑战这些担忧并推动大幅反弹。

Moderna 在宣布与默克公司合作开发的实验性黑色素瘤疫苗取得可喜成果后，在 8 月份领跑该指数，挑战了对其 mRNA 技术能否产生另一项重大突破的怀疑。 “这真是奇迹，所以它受到了奇迹般的欢迎，”克莱默说。 2026 年之前，由于 Covid-19 疫苗的需求下降，Moderna 的股价多年来一直承受压力。

企业软件在八月份的其他大幅反弹中占了很大一部分。由于投资者质疑人工智能时代软件的耐用性，Palantir、Veeva Systems、Salesforce 和 ServiceNow 都面临不同程度的抛售。克莱默表示，态势感知基金的存在加剧了这些跌势，该基金是一家高杠杆基金，基于该论点对软件股进行了大量押注。七月下旬，态势感知被迫平仓。

他表示：“随着八月即将结束，很难相信对冲基金崩溃的影响会对这个月的行动产生如此大的影响。”

克莱默表示，考虑到 Palantir 收入增长和盈利能力的出色结合，其早期的下跌毫无意义。 Salesforce 在一个强劲的季度削弱了人们对“SaaS 末日”的担忧后出现反弹，而 ServiceNow 在表明它可以成功地将人工智能整合到其现有业务中后出现反弹。专注于生命科学行业的 Veeva 也与更广泛的软件集团一起反弹，因为人们担心人工智能会扰乱其业务，事实证明这一担忧被夸大了。

克莱默说：“软件从令人难以置信的低迷水平中恢复过来是令人惊叹的。”

Gartner 早些时候因担心 Anthropic 的 Claude 等人工智能模型可能会减少对其技术研究的需求而受到打击，随后也加入了反弹行列。克莱默表示，这些担忧最终并未反映在公司的业务中。

在软件之外，矿商 Newmont 受益于金价的复苏，金价去年一直飙升，直到 2026 年初才触顶。可以肯定的是，克莱默表示，他更喜欢矿业公司 Agnico Eagle Mines 的股票，而不是纽蒙特公司的股票。

派拉蒙 Skydance 也因收购华纳兄弟探索频道的计划仍被推迟而反弹。上周，加州总检察长罗布·邦塔 (Rob Bonta) 取消了与派拉蒙 Skydance 的会面，因为该公司在早期和解谈判中表现出“缺乏诚意”。克莱默表示，投资者认为派拉蒙出价过高，这意味着完成交易的障碍实际上对该股有所帮助。

由于人工智能数据中心使用的内存需求旺盛，超微电脑和闪迪的股价也大幅上涨。尽管超微在中国的业务受到持续审查，但其股价还是出现了上涨。就Sandisk而言，在经历了残酷的7月份股价下跌超过46%之后，Sandisk在8月份表现强劲。该股仍比 6 月底收盘高点低约 33%。

随着加密货币反弹，Coinbase 也跻身本月表现最佳者之列。此次上涨之际，对政府支出膨胀和美国债务成本上升的担忧促使投资者转向硬资产，以对冲美元疲软的风险。克莱默指出，该股票已成为寻求接触更广泛的加密货币市场的投资者的热门代表。
